name: B10-0329/2025 (ECR) – Tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking China to stop restricting exports of rare earth materials and magnets, which the EU depends on heavily. It calls this pressure "economic blackmail". It wants the EU to work with allies, dig more raw materials inside Europe, build processing capacity, and fully apply its Critical Raw Materials Act. This is an opinion and a set of requests; it does not change any law itself.

- China is asked to lift export limits on seven rare earths and magnets; EU industry and supply chains are affected.
- The EU is urged to diversify suppliers, mine and process more at home, and work with G7 allies.
- Next, the resolution goes to the EU's foreign policy chief, the Council and the Commission; no law changes yet.
